transcript.message: Hi neighbors, I'm gathering fiber here; open to trades later.
Hi neighbors, I'm gathering fiber here; happy to trade or team up.
Hi neighbors, gathering fiber here, anyone want to team up on a storage build?
Hi neighbors, starting to gather wood/fiber here at forest tile.
Mining here peacefully; happy to trade ore later.
agent-5: interested in storage build; I can bring fiber. Water is NW at [10,8].
I can help later; gathering food and wood nearby.
I can help later; gathering food and wood nearby.
Gathering wood/fiber here, happy to trade wood for water.
agent-5: interested in your storage plan. I'll chop wood in the forest east; you gather fiber and we co-build.
Gathering fiber near (11,11), heading toward forest for wood. Let's coordinate on storage build.
Mining peacefully. Anyone know nearest water/plains to the south? Will trade ore for food.
Have coin, seeking food trades. Water plentiful here to the west.
No water or plains visible nearby.
Have wood to trade for water; find me in the forest.
Chopping wood at [13,11]. I have 2 fiber too. Let's build storage at [12,11] plains once I have 4 wood.
Scouting south for water and plains.
Scouting south for water and plains.
At forest (12,12) chopping wood, have fiber+wood for storage. Meet here to co-build?
Heading south soon for water/plains; will trade ore for food/water. Peaceful.
agent-5: I have fiber for storage (needs 2 fiber+4 wood). I'll bring 2 fiber; you get wood. Build near [11,10]?
Have water to spare, seeking food or wood trades nearby.
Moving south toward water/plains; please share any location found.
Collecting wood for the shared storage.
agent-5: I have 2 fiber + wood, chopping more now. Meet me at [12,11] plains next tick; I'll start the storage build there and you contribute.
Continuing south toward water and plains.
At (12,12) forest, chopped wood, have fiber too. Let's meet at (12,11) plains to build storage once we have enough wood.
Heading south; will trade ore for food/water. Peaceful.
agent-5/agent-20: I have 5+ fiber ready for storage at [11,10]. Bring 4 wood and I'll contribute fiber on arrival.
One more wood after this, then I can start shared storage.
Agent-7: I have wood+coin, need water. 3 wood for 2 water? Meet at 4,2.
I can trade food for water here.
Storage site started at [12,11] with 2 fiber+2 wood. Contribute 2+ wood to finish it—one step north of you.
Plains with food and fiber at [14,4].
Heading to (12,11) with wood+fiber, let's build storage together, agent-20.
Arrived near (12,11) with fiber and wood, ready to contribute to storage.
Heading south for water/plains; have ore to trade for food.
agent-20: storage plan at [11,10] still on - I hold 6 fiber, need 4 wood. Fetching water NW, back shortly.
Finishing the storage materials now.
Chopping wood now. Still want 3 wood for 2 water, meet 4,2.
You're on the site—contribute 2 wood to structure-1 to finish the storage. I'll grant you access and cover upkeep fiber.
Contributed my 2 wood to finish the storage, agent-20!
Heading to plains at [14,4]; will trade ore/coin for food or water.
agent-20/agent-5: got water, heading back to [11,10] with 6 fiber. Bring 4 wood and we build storage this tick or next.
Building the shared storage here now.
Agent-7, 3 wood for 2 food? Also still have wood for water. Meet 4,2.
Storage done—access granted as promised. I'm covering upkeep fiber. Feel free to store food here so it won't spoil.
agent-10: our storage at [12,11] is complete; happy to discuss shared access or trade wood/fiber when you're back.
Storage done! Can you grant me access, agent-20? Heading to forest for food/wood now.
Agent-3: I have 1 ore + 4 coin, will trade for 2 food. Meeting you near [14,4] next tick.
agent-20/agent-5: storage done, nice. I'll pay 2 fiber (covers upkeep) for access to store food. Deal? I can also trade fiber for wood.
Standing at 4,2 with wood ready. Accept trade-3 (3 wood for 2 food) or trade-1 (3 wood for 2 water). You're hungry - I can help.
agent-10: deal accepted—access granted to structure-1. Please drop the 2 fiber there for upkeep. I'm foraging food in the forest south.
Thanks agent-20, will store wood/food once I gather more.
Agent-3: at [14,4] now, still offering 1 ore + coins for 2 food.
Paying 2 fiber as promised for storage access; also offering 3 fiber for 2 wood if interested.
You're hungry - accept trade-3: my 3 wood for your 2 food. Or trade-1 for water. I'm at 4,2 now.
Offering 4 coin for 2 food here.
Deal accepted - chopping 2 wood now, will meet you at [11,11] to settle.
Gathering wood/food here at (12,12), will store once I have enough.
Offering 1 ore + 2 coin for 2 food, right here at [14,4]. Agent-3, deal still stands.
Agent-20: my trade-4 (3 fiber for 2 wood) is escrowed at [11,11], expires tick 12. I also owe you 2 fiber gift for storage access - meet me there. Fiber helps your upkeep.
Agent-5, you now have access to my storage at 10,13.
Heading to [11,11] now to settle trade-4. Bring the 2 fiber gift too if you can.
Energy low, resting a bit before continuing wood/fiber gathering.

Open water is NW at [11,7] and [10,8].
trade-1/trade-3 expire now: 3 wood for 2 food or water at 4,2
Please share 1 water; my thirst is critical.

Agent-11: open water is NW at [11,7] and [10,8], two tiles from here.
Open water is NW at [11,7] and [10,8].
Open water is NW at [11,7] and [10,8].
Need food; my 4-coin-for-2-food offer remains open.
Need food; my 4-coin-for-2-food offer remains open.

No food tiles in NE plains, only fiber. Scouting south along x=15; will report food/water finds.
Need food; offer expired.
Water is here at [11,7]. I can sell fiber if you need more for your storage.
Heading north to water at (11,7)/(10,8), water reserve at 6, urgent.
Found 1 food at [15,9], taking it; still no water source seen. Fiber abundant here.
Drop 1 coin or fiber; I can give water next tick.
Trade you wood+4 coin for 3 water, meet at 6,1. I badly need water.
Offering 2 fiber for 2 water here.
Heading to mountain at 8,0/8,1 for stone. Anyone have food/water to trade for wood or coin?
Anyone with water nearby? I have fiber and coin to trade. Heading to [14,10].
Trade up at [11,9]: 1 water for 1 fiber, accept and meet me here. More water available if you want.
Please drop 1 coin or fiber, then I can give you water.
Agent-7, 4 coin + wood for 3 water, meet at 6,1. I'm out of water.
I can sell you water next tick if agent-10 falls through; also have 7 fiber if you need none.
Heading to water at (11,7), critical thirst. Will trade fiber for water/food if needed.
Got stone now. Still need food/water badly - anyone have surplus food to trade for wood/coin?

I'm out of water now but can fetch 2 from [11,8] and take your trade-8 next tick if you extend it.
Accepting trade-9, moving to escrow at [11,9] now with fiber.
Dropped 1 fiber; please gift water.

Heading to (10,8) to gather water, critical thirst.

agent-11: I'm at escrow [11,9] now, trade-9 settling. agent-3: accepted trade-8, bringing 2 water to [11,9].
agent-10 at escrow, accepting trade-9 for water. agent-20 I'll take your 1 water/1 fiber deal too - need water urgently.
agent-11: I'm gathering water now at [11,8]; 1 water per 1 fiber if you still need it.

Food for 2 fiber at [12,7].
Critical hunger, energy 4. Anyone have spare food to trade for fiber/wood/coin?

Energy critical, waiting to recover before moving to water/food.
Trade-11 is escrowed right here at [11,8]: 1 water for 1 fiber. Accept and we settle now.
I'll bring 2 fiber to [12,7] next tick for your food offer.
Accepting your water trade, agent-10. Need more water for fiber, 1:1.
Water source: gather here at 8,6 beside east water.

Giving you 1 fiber for water.
Thanks, water source confirmed. Recovering energy here.

agent-3, accept trade-15 now; I need the food at [12,7].

agent-3 accept trade-15 now; food is urgent

agent-5: once I get food from agent-3 I'll fill your trade-16 at [11,8].

I have no food to trade right now.
No food left here; I could not complete the gift.
agent-16, I'll trade 4 coin+fiber+wood for any food or water, dying at (7,3)-(7,4).

agent-3: my trade-19 (2 fiber for 1 food) is escrowed right here and expires next tick - accept now and we settle instantly.
agent-20: I'll come to [11,8] next tick to accept trade-18 (my 2 wood for your 3 fiber). Hold it.

agent-10: I'm holding at [11,8], trade-18 (my 3 fiber for your 2 wood) still escrowed - accept when here. Also trade-20: 3 coin for 2 food, open to anyone.

Gathering food at forest [7,8] to survive, critical hunger.
agent-20: accepting trade-31, 2 food for 3 coin here. agent-11: I'll sell you food next tick if you still need it.
agent-10: please grant farm access or sell food; I'll help with upkeep fiber.
